acceptanceCriteria: Each listed command either settles a pending receipt under the writer lock or is documented as a read that cannot, with a test reproducing a held-pending receipt per command class.
The Tasks spec states which commands settle a pending redo; help text agrees.
body: Follow-up from PR beamfall/corvint#861 (V1-1352, CAL-V0-222/223). That PR makes leaseCommand (internal/tasks/cli/lease.go) proceed past a pending receipt so the store lease writer settles it under the lock. The builder observed that barrier, policy, import, cutover, escalation and `attempt run`'s initial probe still return the snapshot.Probe REDO_PENDING error as-is at their pre-write probe, so a receipt left pending by a writer killed between receipt link-in and head.json rename (§5.2 C2) refuses them until a ticket mutation settles it. Also recorded by Codex: health and pool cleanup do not carry the redo warning. Suspected defect by code inspection (not reproduced live).
title: corvint-tasks barrier/policy/import/cutover/escalation and attempt run initial probe still refuse REDO_PENDING before the store writer settles it (follow-up to GitHub #860)
